summary: Candidate §4.2.7a addition: dome per-station eclipse coverage vs computed obscuration + dual eclipse baselines
detail: Dome 9-station coverage values vs DE421 max obscuration: EBR 0.95/1.00, SPT 0.90/0.99, ESK 0.55/0.91, LER 0.42/0.88, HAD 0.80/0.94, NGK 0.40/0.85, GUI 0.72/0.69, CLF 0.70/0.93 — up to 46 pp low for northern stations, yet rank-correlated with true obscuration at r=0.978 (globe ordering, rescaled: "Borrowed" branch). Separately, dome live scoring (status_history.json, since 2026-04-05) uses dB = -18.22 x coverage x FSF, predicted -28.9 nT at EBR/SPT, globe_prediction 0.0, falsification "within +/-3 nT of 0" — while V51.1 formula table uses baseline -10.9 nT. Kernel of truth to acknowledge: eclipses do perturb H, and raw values landed in the dome's range at 2 stations. Verbatim dome entry captured in the results draft (prediction_level.dome_live_scoring_entry); recommend decider also save it under data/dome-api-snapshots/. Suggest this is folded into the same curmudgeon pass as the results file; if it needs new prose, decider allocates an EXP (analyst did not self-allocate per PROP-144).
